title: Easy to drive and use
summary: Feedback in this topic mostly describes the vehicle as easy to drive, handle, and use, while a smaller set complains that voice or electronic assistant commands are not recognized reliably.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise straightforward driving, easy handling, comfort, and generally user-friendly operation.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on the electronic assistant failing to understand or respond to simple voice commands.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined snippets mention that the car is simple to drive, handle, or use, but they are too brief or ambiguous to confirm clear sentiment consistently.

limitations: Most sampled evidence in this topic is very short phrase-level feedback, which limits detail about why the vehicle feels simple to drive or use.
The topic blends ease of driving/handling with voice-command recognition issues, so it combines related but distinct usability subjects.
Many reviews are classified as undetermined, so the available examples do not support a fuller sentiment interpretation for those mentions.
